title: Part Four: 1967 and the Land of Israel Movement

sections.brief: What was taken in June 1967 (links to cw6, wb3, gz2 rather than retelling the war); the Golan's population; the government's 19 June 1967 decision (international borders for Egypt and Syria, 10–9 then unanimous; Jordan undecided; Gaza annexation in committee); Khartoum; 242; the territories' later fates. Figure: compare

The Movement for Greater Israel: founding (July/August 1967), the manifesto (what of its text is publicly available online and where the full text sits), its cross-party signatories (Labor, writers, Revisionists, Rabbi Zvi Yehuda Kook), the 1969 list, Likud 1973, La'am 1976; the same-day dissent (Matzpen ad; Siach Lochamim). Figures: time; compare

The Allon Plan as Labor's answer (1967 and 1968 versions, the Hussein talks per FRUS, never adopted, settlement along its lines, Allon 1976); Gush Emunim from 1974 (Kook lineage, Sebastia, Kadum, aims) and the eclipse of the Movement by 1977. Figures: compare; stats
